name: Invention
overview: Scripture acknowledges invention as a God-ordained aspect of human creativity and wisdom, exemplified by Jubal, the father of those who play musical instruments, and Tubalcain, an instructor in working with metals like brass and iron. Proverbs highlights that wisdom and prudence lead to discovering skillful inventions, while Amos references the crafting of musical instruments, associating such creativity with figures like David. These passages collectively demonstrate that invention, whether in music or metallurgy, is a manifestation of God-given knowledge and skill used for both artistic and practical purposes.
